fact: The Parish Development Model's Wendi system, managed by Pearl Bank, disburses the government programme's loans directly to beneficiaries' mobile phones, reaching 3,571,108 beneficiaries, as reported by the Ministry of Finance (14,133 Wendi agents recruited).

Ministry of Gender, Labour and Social Development's SAGE head said the ministry had started piloting mobile money payments of the SAGE older-persons grant as an alternative to the existing payment-point system, to be extended nationwide if the pilot succeeds.

The SAGE programme head said eligible older people are refused the grant because the date of birth on their national ID card puts them below the age-80 threshold, and 43,000 complaints have been received.

Minister of State for Elderly Affairs Dominic Mafwabi Gidudu said SAGE gives senior citizens a monthly cash transfer, and that its payments require bank accounts linked to National Identification Numbers.
Gidudu said SAGE and SEGOP payments require bank accounts linked to National Identification Numbers, so older persons without a national ID will struggle to access them.
